text_block_list.text:
During training, Copano Rickey got injured,
so I brought her to the nurse's office.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ow, ow, ow... Ehehe, sorry, Trainer.
I messed up a little bit.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: “It really doesn't hurt that much, so I'm fine! Let's get right back to training!”
choice_data_list: We've got to handle this carefully.
We'll have to be careful about this.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: “It really doesn't hurt that much, so I'm fine! Let's get right back to training!”
choice_data_list: We've got to handle this carefully.
We'll have to be careful about this.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
What?! 
But, doing this much is...
choice_data_list: Will pushing myself actually improve my luck?
Does pushing yourself actually improve your luck?

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
No, pushing yourself won't improve your luck.
If anything, it'll disrupt the qi in your body and make you even unluckier.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
"...Haste makes waste. Trainer's right,
I really need to get some proper rest."

Although she agreed to focus on resting,
Copano Rickey seemed somewhat downcast...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Of course!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: "We have to prove that with the power of feng shui, you can overcome even injuries!"

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Alright, the flow of qi disrupted by the injury
should be settled down now...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Here I gooo!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Ow ow ow ow... The spot I hurt earlier
just went out on me again...

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Trainerrr... It looks like today's
just no good after all...

Soothing Copano Rickey by telling her that some days are just like that,
I took her to the nurse's office once more.

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, feeling good!
The flow of qi is giving me a push from behind!

text_block_list.name: Copano Rickey
text_block_list.text: Keep this momentum going... Yaaahhh!

And so, Copano Rickey ran around,
keeping it within a reasonable pace.
